reasoning_traces.think:
The debugging process is modeled as a sequential Bayesian update over operational states. Let \( S \) denote the symptom, \( D \) the deployment state, and \( T \) the set of tools. The system computes \( P(S|D) \) to assess deviation from expected behavior. When \( D \neq \text{origin/main} \), a consistency check triggers. Hypotheses \( H_i \) are ranked based on \( P(H_i|S,T) \propto P(S|H_i,T)P(H_i) \). Evidence from logs and code is gathered to compute likelihoods. The root cause is \( H^* = \arg\max_{H_i} P(H_i|S,T) \). A minimal fix \( F \) is proposed such that \( \Delta \text{state} = \text{apply}(F) \) resolves \( S \). This process is formalized as a belief propagation in a directed acyclic graph over \( \{S, D, T, H_i, F\} \).
